description: HOLE-POSITION-FORMULA: a 120 x 40 x 10 plate with a Ø10 through hole whose face-frame X is the formula W - 20, as documents sends it to geometry for W = 100 -- numbers only, the formula resolved and stripped, the world position derived from (face_x_mm, face_y_mm) = (80, 20). parametric.json beside it holds the stored tree (formula kept) and the re-drive W = 80 that moves the hole to x = 60; test_parametric_goldens.py proves this model.json IS that tree resolved, and rebuilds the re-drive.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, not recorded harness output (geometry-gates skill).

parameters: W = 100 mm; hole face X = W - 20 = 80, face Y = 20. The top face (normal +Z, z = 10) has its frame origin at the part origin projected onto it, (0, 0, 10), and axes +X / +Y, so the bore axis is x = 80, y = 20
centroid x = (48000*60 - 250*pi*80) / (48000 - 250*pi) = 59.667307090244876; y = 20 and z = 5 by symmetry; bounding_box = [0,0,0]..[120,40,10] (the bore is interior)
topology: 6 block faces + 1 bore face = 7 faces; 12 block edges + 2 bore circles + 1 seam = 15 edges; 1 shell (as hole-through-r5-40x25x10)
mesh (linear_deflection 0.1): 530 vertices / 520 triangles, the same counts as hole-through-r5-40x25x10 (the same Ø10 x 10 bore in a box); the re-drive only translates the bore and keeps them
no material is assigned, so mass and centre of mass must be reported ABSENT (null), never 0 g
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill). Measured deviations vs the analytic values (2026-10-10, build123d / OCCT 7.9): volume, area and centroid x equal their closed forms as doubles; centroid y, z within 4e-15 mm; AABB exactly 0.0. The re-drive (W = 80) is held to the same bound by test_parametric_goldens.py. 1e-9 is the sibling hole-through-r5-40x25x10 ceiling. The parameter path adds no error: W - 20 resolves to exact doubles. Loosening this bound requires a reviewed kernel-level justification.
